messages:
olivia: DeployBot just tripped a hard canary in eu-north1 after the midnight rollout. p50 ~5x and a few 502s. tagging @oncall_mai @raj for fast decision - pin previous image or rollback global?

raj: looking at traces. Spike confined to hosts with the new glibc image. Model artifact identical. My vote: regional pin first to stop user impact, then decide.

oncall_mai: agree pin is lowest risk. We need a quick owner for release-note edits if we revert regionally (notes are already published). Also need a signoff to run the pin command.

deploybot: Canary status: failures=7, p50-ms=510 -> threshold-exceeded. Actions: `pin-region` or `rollback-global`. Use `/deploy fast-approve <action>` to proceed.

olivia: if we pin, we'll keep global routes and avoid churn. Execute: `/deploy pin --region eu-north1 --image redwood/serve:2026.03.01-stable --reason "post-release glibc perf regression"`

oncall_mai: executing now.

releasebot: Pin request accepted. Rolling pin in eu-north1. Expected duration ~3m. Notifying release owners.

docs_eng: I'll prepare a short release-note patch: "Temporarily reverted libc/kernel image in eu-north1 due to latency spike; monitoring." Shall I open PR now?

raj: yes please, link PR here. Also create INFRA-4510 with host-ids and traces and loop infra team.

infra_team: INFRA-4510 created and assigned to infra-lead. Kernel/glibc rollout job id attached.

deploybot: Pin complete: 6/6 hosts pinned. Health checks: passing. Telemetry: p50 back to baseline within 90s. Error-rate dropped to 0.08%.

olivia: good. docs_eng please push the PR and tag security if customer-visible. 

docs_eng: PR -> https://git.internal/docs/PR-1209. Short blurb added. Tagging security for review.

oncall_mai: will keep elevated canary for eu-north1 for 12h and monitor dashboards. If we see recurrence we escalate to rollback-global.

raj: filing a follow-up to validate the image pipeline to prevent auto-rolls without perf checks. INFRA-4511 created.

releasebot: Release note PR merged. Changelog updated.

olivia: thanks team. Closing expedited approval. Reopen if alerts return or infra requests rollback.
